description: Use for the raw daily series: one row per day with the Score, its classification and a live or backtested mark (daily since July 18, 2011, backtested with the current method before live publication), as JSON or CSV, 100 rows a page. Choose it to chart or export values; for one day use get_score_for_day, for summaries get_score_statistics, for classification periods get_classification_history. Free through the Delayed date (the free cut-off, three months before the latest published day). A later "to", or live = true, costs $0.25 in bitcoin over Lightning, one payment for every page of that query, no subscription: the first call returns an invoice instead of data (steps under payment). Example: from 2024-01-01, to 2024-03-31 and format csv return that quarter as one table; a range longer than a page comes back in parts, so repeat the same call with page = next_page until next_page is null.

export.description: true: the whole record through the latest published day, 1000 rows a page, $1.00 once for all its pages within 24 hours. Default false.

format.description: json (default): rows as objects. csv: one text table with the header date,score,score_exact,level,change,pct_below,basis, for spreadsheets.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, included. Default without from, to or page: the last 30 days of the free record, newest last; give from (for example 2011-07-18, the start) for an earlier range.

live.description: true: data through the latest published day, paid ($0.25). Omit or false: the free answer, through the Delayed date.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). A page is 100 rows; take next_page from the answer, null on the last page.

payment.description: Omit on the first call: a paid request then returns a Lightning invoice (valid 10 minutes) and a macaroon instead of data. Pay it, then repeat the call with the same other arguments and payment = "<macaroon>:<preimage>" (the preimage your wallet shows once paid) within 24 hours. A used, expired or mismatched proof is refused with the reason; call again without payment for a new invoice.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, included. Default: the Delayed date, or the latest published day with live = true. A day after the Delayed date is paid ($0.25).

name: get_score_history

as_of.description: UTC: the last day the answer covers (YYYY-MM-DD), or for the Brief and methodology the time it was published (ISO 8601)

delayed_through.description: The Delayed date: free answers stop here
